# Java nb3 compatibility fixture

`original.nb3` was generated by `crates/core/tests/java/BackupFormatGolden.java`
using the original Java `BackupService` metadata models, SQL literal formatter,
gzip helper and archive layout. It contains three synthetic rows only; no saved
connection was opened and no user data was read.

SHA-256: `E9205AECC3526F311FCE85C824C8D711B558AF97CE7AA4A824C86CA1D33AB87C`.
The gzip checksums inside the archive cover compressed bytes, as in Java.
The second row contains the record separator inside a quoted SQL string.

The default format tests read this archive and validate names, checksums, rows,
native output and failure cleanup. The ignored `database_servers::backup` test
actually restores it to an isolated MySQL database, exports 2,004 rows plus a
view, function and event, restores the native output, compares typed values,
and cancels an in-progress export. Run it through the isolated database runner;
never use a saved connection for this regression.
